text_block_list.text: One day, when I went to the cafeteria with Maruzensky...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Staff
text_block_list.text: Fresh batch just added: 'Extra Dragée! Sparkling Shortcake'!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, look!
That cake looks so fab~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, look!
That cake looks so fab~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it kinda look like a mirror ball?
Even the cake is so groovy, just as expected~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ooh-ooh... Endure, endure...
Can't go yet~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Is that girl...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hauuu~, auuuu~.
Maya's in dead last, dead last...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan.
You've been groaning and sighing, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's Maruzen-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wait, my bad, wrong one!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Maruzen-chan.
Hehe... Good afternoon to you.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like she's flipped a switch.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be she's trying her best at something again
to become a 'mature woman'?"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly, that's right!
Right now, I'm just waiting!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wait... for what?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: There's only one sparkling cake left!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya wants to eat cake real soon too, but
a mature woman knows how to wait...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that's why you're letting them go ahead.
I suppose it's the mature thing to do, but still...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, when you have delicious food right in front of you,
don't you think holding back is just nonsense?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This is where a real "adult"
should step in with some advice♪
choice_data_list: Maruzensky is the perfect one for the job.
Maruzensky would be perfect for the job.
Jumping out in front first is a job for the grown-ups, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
This is where a real "adult"
should step in with some advice♪
choice_data_list: Maruzensky is the perfect one for the job.
Maruzensky would be perfect for the job.
Jumping out in front first is a job for the grown-ups, too.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my☆
Thanks for picking me♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: "Yeah~ If it were me, naturally, I'd go all-in without a second thought!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Even though you're an adult?
Can't you wait for them~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Of course, sweeping everything would be a bit childish, but...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
When you're faced with something you love,
letting loose without holding back is the adult way to do it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! If super-duper mature
Maruzen-chan says so, it must be true!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Wait, what do you mean by super-duper mature—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well then, Maya's gonna stop waiting☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there she goes...
Once she makes up her mind, she moves super fast as always.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Is that what they call youth?
Then I can't let myself lose either!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Maya-chan, wait up, wait up~!
I wanna eat too☆
Afterward, Maruzensky ate cake with Mayano Top Gun and was thoroughly satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh, really?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! It means leading the way
so it's easier for the next ones to follow♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so that works too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
True, Maruzen-chan always dashes out first
for pretty much everything, after all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah! I'm a trendy gyaru, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And by the time it's over, you're usually totally wiped out and slumped over, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: *Stab!*

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya thinks she gets it now, maybe☆ Thanks, you two♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: E-Eat to your heart's content...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...I thought I was hiding it well,
but she's remarkably observant...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, exactly!
Nice save...

She seemed a tiny bit hurt at first, but eating
some cake Mayano Top Gun brought over
soon cheered her right back up.
